principles_applied: Define an implementable visual grammar rather than mood adjectives.
Trace composition to page role, user question, owner message and decision object.
Use one purposeful visual device and avoid repeated generic card/hero shells.
Treat image crop and media direction as design decisions.
Recognition must come from multiple repeatable cues, not logo plus primary color.
Keep interaction conventions familiar while making composition and expression ownable.
Test whether representative screens remain coherent with logo/header mentally removed.
Challenge interchangeable template defaults after direction exists.
Concentrate boldness in one memorable commitment rather than many novelty devices.
Use KEEP / REVISE / REMOVE against rendered evidence.
applied_to: Scent Portrait as the primary memorable commitment

principles_applied: Every interaction defines what the user sees, does, receives and how they recover.
Multi-step flows should reduce cognitive load, show meaningful progress and preserve data on back.
Controls need explicit labels/states and keyboard-visible focus.
Source/build success is not visual QA; inspect actual rendered evidence.
Review macro hierarchy and anti-template composition before micro polish.
Treat broken focal media, overflow, invisible states and obvious visual sanity failures as blockers.

reference_boundary: External fragrance sites inform discovery/trial principles only. Violet does not copy their branded layouts, copy, imagery or identity assets.
